# CS-011: fail2ban ignores the tailnet range when Tailscale is used

- **Group:** CrowdSec and fail2ban
- **Severity when it fails:** low
- **Root:** not needed

## Why it matters

Without 100.64.0.0/10 in ignoreip, a few mistyped logins from a tailnet peer ban that peer, which can cut off your only private path to the host.

## Verify by hand

```sh
grep -r ignoreip /etc/fail2ban/jail.local /etc/fail2ban/jail.d
```

## How to fix it

Add 100.64.0.0/10 (and fd7a:115c:a1e0::/48) to ignoreip in jail.local [DEFAULT]

## What a fix can break

A compromised tailnet peer is no longer banned by fail2ban; tailnet ACLs are the control for that.

Run `stackward explain CS-011` for the same text in your terminal. [All checks](index.md).
